## Affected files
- AGENTS.md — intro paragraph (line ~7), 'paces the seven organs' wording

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Root AGENTS.md intro no longer states 'seven organs' as the default pacing
- [ ] Intro accurately reflects that predictor is now opt-in (default AGENT_ROLES: review,dev,gardener,architect,planner,supervisor)
- [ ] No other doc (README, per-agent AGENTS.md) contradicts the corrected organ count
